title: Your first trade for Tuesday, Sep 18
text:
The " Fast Money " traders shared their first moves for the market open.
Tim Seymour was a buyer of Philip Morris .
Karen Finerman was a buyer of FedEx .
Steve Grasso was a buyer of General Electric .
Guy Adami was a buyer of Kroger .
